logger.doc:name: Start Get Case Report Logger
logger.message: transactionID: #[vars.transactionId], correlationID: #[vars.correlationId], message: "started get case report flow ": #[payload]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain var st = (attributes.queryParams.state default "") as String --- if (!isEmpty(trim(st))) "select count(*) as count, case_type, state from cvd_case_master where upper(state) = '" ++ upper(trim(st)) ++ "' group by case_type, state" else "select count(*) as count, case_type, state from cvd_case_master group by case_type, state"

logger.doc:name: End Get Case Report Logger
logger.message: transactionID: #[vars.transactionId], correlationID: #[vars.correlationId], message: "end get case report flow ": #[payload]
